homebrews.name: PS2BBL
homebrews.description: Bootloader; required for the generated Memory Card setup.

homebrews.name: OSDMenu
homebrews.description: OSDSYS-style launcher used by the generated R1 shortcut.

homebrews.name: DKWDRV
homebrews.description: Unified PS1DRV project for PS1 discs/USB on PS2.

homebrews.name: OPL Evolution
homebrews.description: Experimental OPL fork; keep a known-good recovery OPL.

homebrews.name: RetroArch PS2 bundle
homebrews.description: Full PS2 RetroArch ELF/core bundle; stable or nightly.

homebrews.name: POPStarter
homebrews.description: PS1 launcher using Sony POPS components supplied separately.
homebrews.manual_note: POPStarter itself can be obtained from PSX-Place, but Sony POPS/BIOS files are not bundled. Follow the project instructions and use only components you are legally entitled to use.

homebrews.name: POPSLoader Fork
homebrews.manual_note: Hardware/storage-specific setup. The installer records the source but does not bundle POPStarter or Sony POPS components.

homebrews.name: Ember
homebrews.manual_note: Ember expects ember.elf plus a user-supplied legally dumped bios.bin and your own games. No BIOS is downloaded or copied by Ps2Installer.

homebrews.name: Project Titan Magenta Edition
homebrews.manual_note: Project Titan has its own boot chain/runtime/package system and is not treated as a normal APPS ELF. Follow its deployment documentation.

homebrews.name: RETROLauncher
homebrews.description: Lua retro frontend integrating RetroArch, POPStarter, Neutrino, wLaunchELF and OPL.
homebrews.manual_note: No simple GitHub release asset is published; follow the repository documentation and copy the complete RETROLauncher environment.

homebrews.name: PGEN
homebrews.manual_note: Legacy project/mirror without a reliable current GitHub release asset; use the linked project documentation/source.

homebrews.name: Neutrino
homebrews.description: Small modular PS2 game loader used by NHDDL and other frontends.
homebrews.manual_note: Neutrino requires its module/config tree, so this catalog keeps it manual until the installer has version-specific module deployment rules.

homebrews.name: NHDDL
homebrews.description: Launcher/front-end for Neutrino with exFAT/MMCE/APA support.
homebrews.manual_note: NHDDL is tightly coupled to compatible Neutrino builds/configuration. Follow the release notes for the matching Neutrino version.

homebrews.name: wOPL
homebrews.manual_note: Releases contain multiple build variants. Choose the desired variant manually rather than letting Ps2Installer guess.
